details: PLAUSIBLE (a paid run or a hook test would show it). Principle 5: "Code checks what can be checked exactly; the
model decides what needs understanding." The number of tool calls an agent made is an exact fact available in its
transcript (hook input has transcript_path); asking the model to count 72 calls is the model doing a fact's job.
The judge base already carries the same counting rule ("after about 60 tool calls"), and the evidence case shows the
"you have 80 turns" sentence alone did not save the worker. The change keeps to fewer parts (principle 7), which is
why this is a finding and not a design reversal: one PreToolUse hook in plugins/delegate/hooks is the smallest
code path. Size: 45. If the owner prefers text only, this becomes a question.
evidence: git show master:plugins/delegate/agents/worker.md | grep "Turn limit" -> "Turn limit: you have 80 turns."
wave-red transcript, last lines: a 220 s wait loop on pytest (pid 98483) printed RUNNING, then no hand-back.
ls plugins/delegate/hooks -> hooks.json, route-guard.py (no turn count)
failing_case: The wave-red worker (maxTurns 80) already had "Turn limit: you have 80 turns" in its text and stopped at its 81st
tool use with no hand-back. With this change it must also notice, unaided, that 72 tool calls have passed; nothing
tells it the count. A worker that loses count at turn 75 starts a 220 s wait at turn 79 and dies exactly as before.
Should: the agent is told its turn count by code when 8 turns remain, so the hand-back does not depend on counting.
fix_hint: A small hook (PreToolUse, delegate plugin) that, for a subagent call, counts tool_use entries in the transcript and,
at maxTurns - 8 (runner: - 2), returns additionalContext with the hand-back sentence. Test with a fake transcript
pass_cases: 1. A subagent with maxTurns 80 reaches its 72nd tool call: it receives a message such as "8 turns left: write your
report; if a job runs, hand back BLOCKED with still running: <log>".
2. The same agent at its 40th tool call receives nothing extra.
3. The runner (maxTurns 12) gets the message at its 10th tool call.
4. The main session gets no such message.
5. If no hook can read the count, the owner decides (recorded as a question), and the text stays as it is.
reason: Fixer reports a Gap: a PreToolUse hook counting turns is not built; unknown whether hook input identifies the subagent. My view: a real principle-5 gap, but needs the owner's choice between a hook (45 min) and text only.
findings.summary: the 8-turns-left hand-back rests on the model counting its own tool calls (principle 5: fact to code)
